source_dataset: Indian Patent Office (IPO / InPASS) & TKDL Patent Corpus
title: Standardized herbal anti-diabetic composition comprising Gymnema sylvestre, Momordica charantia, and Cinnamomum zeylanicum
text: Detailed investigation of Indian medicinal plants recognized for Madhumeha revealed that combining gymnemic acids (which stimulate insulin secretion from beta-cells) with charantin (which mimics insulin activity) and cinnamon polyphenols (which enhance insulin receptor phosphorylation) produces an unprecedented multi-target therapeutic benefit.
